stories.title: Patriotic Celebration or Trump Rally? America's Divided 250th Birthday
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Delivers Historic Fireworks Show for America's 250th Birthday Celebration
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Hijacks America's 250th Anniversary, Turns National Celebration Into Personal Political Rally
stories.poll_question: Should America's 250th anniversary celebration be nonpartisan or can presidents personalize it?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Presidents should lead anniversary celebrations reflecting their vision for America
stories.poll_option2_desc: National milestones should unite all Americans beyond any president's brand

stories.title: Principled Stand or Career Suicide? Air Force Major Calls for Trump Impeachment
stories.conservative_headline: Active Duty Officer Breaks Military Code, Arrested for Partisan Political Protest at Capitol
stories.liberal_headline: Courageous Air Force Major Risks Career to Defend Constitution, Call for Trump's Removal
stories.poll_question: Was the Air Force major's impeachment protest heroic or a violation of military duty?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Military members must remain apolitical and follow rules against partisan activism
stories.poll_option2_desc: Speaking truth to power when democracy is threatened transcends military protocol

stories.title: Presidential Leverage or Hostage-Taking? Trump Refuses to Sign Housing Bill
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Stands Firm: No Housing Bill Until Congress Secures Elections with SAVE Act
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Holds Americans' Housing Crisis Hostage to Push Restrictive Voter ID Requirements
stories.poll_question: Is Trump right to withhold signing a housing bill until election security passes?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Protecting election integrity matters more than any single policy bill
stories.poll_option2_desc: Bipartisan bills addressing crises shouldn't be leverage for partisan wish lists

stories.title: Executive Power or Constitutional Crisis? Supreme Court Split on Trump Firing Authority
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Affirms Presidential Authority to Remove Insubordinate Agency Officials
stories.liberal_headline: Court Protects Fed Independence While Dangerously Expanding Trump's Firing Powers
stories.poll_question: Should presidents have power to fire independent agency leaders at will?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Elected presidents must control executive branch officials they can't work with
stories.poll_option2_desc: Independent agencies need protection from political interference to function properly

stories.title: Free Speech Hero or Political Vandal? Olympian Charged in Reflecting Pool Damage
stories.conservative_headline: Former Olympian Faces Felony After Damaging National Monument During Anti-Trump Protest
stories.liberal_headline: Activist Charged for Symbolic Protest Against Trump's Mismanagement of Historic Pool
stories.poll_question: Should protesters face felony charges for damaging monuments to make a point?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Vandalism of national monuments is never acceptable regardless of political message
stories.poll_option2_desc: Felony charges for minor damage during protest chill legitimate political dissent

stories.title: Rebuilding America or Blocking Investors? Housing Bill Limits Wall Street Purchases
stories.conservative_headline: Congress Attacks Free Market, Blocks Private Investment in Single-Family Homes
stories.liberal_headline: Historic Housing Bill Finally Stops Wall Street from Buying Up American Dream
stories.poll_question: Should large investors be prohibited from buying single-family homes?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Government shouldn't restrict legal property investment by private companies
stories.poll_option2_desc: Corporate landlords drive up prices and lock families out of homeownership

stories.title: Election Integrity or Voter Suppression? The SAVE Act Divides Washington

stories.liberal_headline: Trump's SAVE Act Would Create Massive Barriers to Voting for Millions of Citizens
stories.poll_question: Should voters be required to prove citizenship when registering to vote?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Only citizens should vote; requiring proof ensures election integrity
stories.poll_option2_desc: Citizenship requirements create obstacles for eligible voters without proper documents

stories.title: Draining the Swamp or Destroying Expertise? Trump Targets Independent Agencies

stories.liberal_headline: Trump Purges Expert Officials, Dismantles Agencies Designed to Check Presidential Power
stories.poll_question: Should presidents control all executive branch agencies or should some remain independent?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Voters elect presidents to run government; unelected bureaucrats shouldn't be untouchable
stories.poll_option2_desc: Technical agencies need independence from politics to regulate fairly and effectively

stories.title: Youth Revolution or Socialist Takeover? Progressive Primary Wins Reshape Democrats

stories.liberal_headline: Progressive Wave: Young Democrats Defeat Establishment Incumbents in Historic Primary Wins

stories.poll_option1_desc: Socialist takeover pushes Democrats too far left to win general elections
stories.poll_option2_desc: New generation brings energy and addresses issues establishment Democrats ignore

stories.title: Patriotic Duty or Propaganda Machine? PBS Boycotts Trump's July 4th Fireworks

stories.liberal_headline: PBS Preserves Nonpartisan Tradition, Broadcasts from Williamsburg Instead of Trump Rally
stories.poll_question: Should PBS have broadcast Trump's July 4th fireworks from the National Mall?
stories.poll_option1_desc: PBS should broadcast official national celebrations regardless of who's president
stories.poll_option2_desc: Public broadcasting shouldn't promote partisan events masquerading as national celebrations
